goal: The Owner must SEE real AX Branch execution in the app without asking anyone: who works, what they do, which engine, whether it is really active, what finished, what is next, whether recovery happened. Visibility costs zero LLM calls: it is derived only from local state (SQLite events/plan, supervisor.status(), HEARTBEAT.json / ACTIVITY.json). Never fake activity: a stage counts as running only when supervisor.status() says ACTIVE.
task:
Create axbranch/live.py with two functions.

1) view(workspace, store, pid) -> dict with keys 'header', 'pipeline', 'timeline'.

- 'header': list of (label, value) string pairs, in this order: 프로젝트 (pid), 목표 (goal, <=120 chars), 단계 (stage), 상태 (status + ' — ' + reason), 에이전트 / 역할 (agent), 엔진 (provider shown as Claude / Codex / Local; unknown names shown as given), worker pid, provider pid, 현재 작업, 경과 / 제한 (call_elapsed / call_timeout as '12m 31s / 30m 00s'), 마지막 활동 ('N초 전' from last_meaningful_activity_age), 산출물 (artifact_version as 'vN'), 복구 횟수 (recovery_count), 다음 작업 (next_action). All values come from supervisor.status(workspace, store, pid) (read axbranch/supervisor.py) plus store.project(pid).
  REAL STATE RULE: agent, provider, provider pid and elapsed are shown as current only when status == 'ACTIVE' and a provider call is live (call_elapsed is not None). Otherwise the agent value is prefixed '마지막: ' and provider pid / elapsed show '-'.
  현재 작업: ACTIVE with a live call -> '<agent> on <Engine>'; ACTIVE without a live call -> the 'detail' of workspace/projects/<pid>/HEARTBEAT.json, where a detail starting with 'runtime:' is shown as 'LOCAL — Runtime acceptance: <rest>'; otherwise '없음 (' + status + ')'.

- 'pipeline': list of dicts {mark, title, engine, detail}; mark is '✓' done, '●' running, '✗' failed, '!' interrupted, '○' not started. The CURRENT production round = events after the latest 'state' event with to == 'STAFFING' (if none, all events). Rows:
  (a) '淸月 CEO': ✓, detail = 'what' of the latest 'decision' event whose by != 'engine' (any time), engine from its 'by'.
  (b) one row per stage of store.project(pid)['plan']['pipeline'] (title = agent_role, planned engine = stage provider): ✓ if a 'call' event with who == agent_role exists in the round (detail 'Completed · <duration>' from seconds, engine = that call's provider); ✗ if its latest event is 'call_failed' (detail = error[:80]); if its latest is 'call_start' with no later call: ● when status is ACTIVE (detail '<status> · <elapsed> / <timeout> · 마지막 활동 N초 전'), else '!' with detail 'interrupted — ' + status; else ○. A 'build_rejected' event in the round marks the LAST stage ✗ with detail 'no deliverable: ' + reason.
  (c) 'Verification Agent': ✓ (PASS) / ✗ (FAIL) from a 'verification' event in the round (detail verdict + ' · ' + Engine(provider)); ● if the latest call_start in the round has who == 'Verification' with no later call and status ACTIVE; else ○.
  (d) 'Runtime Acceptance (LOCAL)': ● when status ACTIVE, stage VERIFYING and the HEARTBEAT detail starts with 'runtime:' (detail = that step); after a verification in the round, the latest store.verifications(pid) entry's checks.get('runtime') if present -> ✓ when ok else ✗, detail '<passed> / <total> checks passed' (its 'steps' list; each step has 'ok'); else ○.
  (e) 'OWNER_REVIEW': ● with detail 'Owner 확인 대기' when the project state is OWNER_REVIEW; ✓ when PENDING_CLOSE / ARCHIVE_PENDING_APPROVAL / ARCHIVING / CLOSED; else ○.

- 'timeline': the latest 30 events mapped to dicts {at: 'HH:MM:SS' local time, actor, text}:
  decision -> ('淸月 CEO', or 'ENGINE' when by == 'engine'; '→ ' + what)
  agent_hired -> two rows ('淸月 CEO', '→ hired ' + role) and ('淸月 CEO', 'Assigned engine: ' + Engine(provider))
  call_start -> (who, 'started · ' + Engine(preferred))
  call -> (who, 'completed · ' + duration + ' · ' + Engine(provider))
  call_failed -> (who, 'failed: ' + error[:80])
  provider_handoff -> (who, 'engine switched ' + preferred + ' → ' + used)
  state -> ('STATE', frm + ' → ' + to + (' (' + reason[:80] + ')' if reason))
  verification -> ('Verification Agent', verdict + ' (round ' + iteration + ', ' + Engine(provider) + ')')
  build_rejected -> ('LOCAL', 'build rejected: ' + reason)
  edits_applied -> ('LOCAL', count + ' edits applied to v' + base_version)
  recovery -> ('SUPERVISOR', 'recovery: ' + action + ' (attempt ' + attempt + ')')
  recovery_replan -> ('淸月 CEO', 'recovery re-plan')
  approval_requested -> ('GATE', 'approval asked: ' + subject)
  approval_decided -> ('OWNER', subject + ' ' + status)
  approval_reused / permission_granted -> ('GATE', short text)
  owner_feedback -> ('OWNER', text[:80])
  owner_action -> ('OWNER', action + ' via ' + channel)
  session -> ('LOCAL', 'engine session started (pid ' + os_pid + ')')
  any other kind -> (kind, short key=value summary <=100 chars)
  Missing detail keys must never raise.

Durations: '<m>m <ss>s' when >= 60 s, else '<s>s'. Engine(x): claude -> Claude, codex -> Codex, engine/local -> Local, None -> '-', else x.

2) render(v) -> str: plain text for a Tk Text widget: '━ 실행 현황 (로컬 상태 · AI 호출 없음) ━' then 'label: value' lines; then '━ 파이프라인 ━' with '<mark> <title>' per row and an indented second line '    Engine: <engine> · <detail>' (omit empty parts); then '━ 타임라인 ━' with '[HH:MM:SS] <actor> <text>' lines, newest LAST.

Tests in tests/test_live.py (unittest, temp dirs, real Store and run_lock; scripted state only, no providers):
 (1) ACTIVE: lock held + ACTIVITY.json + HEARTBEAT.json -> the running stage row is ●; header agent has no '마지막' prefix and shows the provider pid;
 (2) stale EXECUTING (no lock held) -> no ● row; the started stage is '!' interrupted; header agent prefixed '마지막: '; 현재 작업 starts with '없음';
 (3) agent_hired + call_start + call(seconds=266) events produce 'hired', 'Assigned engine: Codex' and 'Completed · 4m 26s' text;
 (4) a verification FAIL and a build_rejected give ✗ rows;
 (5) project state OWNER_REVIEW -> the OWNER_REVIEW row is ●;
 (6) a 'runtime: ...' heartbeat while ACTIVE in VERIFYING -> 'LOCAL — Runtime acceptance' in 현재 작업;
 (7) no LLM: patch axbranch.providers.call to raise; view + render still work.
See tests/test_supervisor.py for how ACTIVITY.json / HEARTBEAT.json / run_lock are set up.
contract: live.view(workspace, store, pid) -> {'header': [(str, str)], 'pipeline': [{'mark','title','engine','detail'}], 'timeline': [{'at','actor','text'}]}; live.render(view) -> str. Pure reads: never writes SQLite or files, never imports or calls providers, never starts processes. Uses supervisor.status() for liveness (do not re-implement it). Events come from store.events(pid) (dicts with 'kind', 'at', 'detail'). Standard library only.
constraints: Only the two allowed files. Small and readable. Korean labels exactly as given. The Codex sandbox may be unable to run Python on this PC; the host runs the tests afterwards, so write the tests carefully.
expected_output: axbranch/live.py + tests/test_live.py; tests pass; full suite passes.
